scope: Read-only documentation and presentation of committed experiments; no retraining, deduplication or result replacement

claims.claim: Dataset counts, units, ranges, missing values and duplicate measurements; Table 1 and Figure 2
claims.verification: Computed from current stored rows. 189 rows; 21 filenames; 9 rows per filename; 0 missing cells; 0 full-record duplicates with source; 9 duplicate measurement records without source identity. Within-file intervals 35–92 minutes.
claims.qualification: 21 filename groups do not establish 21 distinct dates. solar_data_tue_21st.csv and solar_data_tue_28st.csv repeat measurements. No source rows changed. Collection location is documented, not independently verified. Calendar period and calibration records are unavailable.

claims.claim: Author, undergraduate completion in 2023, original architecture and historical reassessment
claims.verification: Original repository read via GitHub connector at commit 578401bb0d106c53f0e152380441a8338854ed57. README reports five inputs, fitnet(10), tansig/purelin, trainlm, daily mapminmax and daily train/test reuse. NeuralNet.m explicitly uses 80/10/10 random division, five files and a 9000-epoch cap.
claims.qualification: NeuralNet.m converts time to numeric and includes every non-target column, conflicting with five-input README description. README-reported daily function is absent from inspected tree. Exact historical results are not independently verified.

claims.claim: Experimental feature configurations; Table 2; electrical relation and task distinction
claims.verification: Track A: solar_irradiance,current,voltage,temperature,humidity. Track B: solar_irradiance,temperature,humidity,hour. Physics uses current*voltage only. No future horizon or forecast weather inputs.
claims.qualification: Feature-target dependence is distinct from preprocessing leakage. Availability depends on the deployment task.

claims.claim: Preprocessing, architectures, optimisers, stopping and selection; Table 3; Figures 1 and 3
claims.verification: 7 outer filename-group folds; 3 inner folds; seeds 0,1,2. Sklearn tuned grid: hidden 3/10, alpha 0.1/1/10, tanh, L-BFGS max_iter 5000. S2: candidates (10,) and (16,8), tanh, Adam lr 0.01, hidden L2 0.0001, batch 16, cap 1000, patience 30. Training-partition input scaling; TF/PT also scale targets. Median inner best epochs set outer refit duration.
claims.qualification: Untuned MLP and baselines have different selection procedures. The mean prediction is a synthetic metric sanity check in evaluate.py, not a saved research baseline. baselines.py contains an in-sample linear check that is not the manuscript's CV source.

claims.claim: All abstract and discussion performance numbers; Tables 4–6; Figure 5; within-track rankings
claims.verification: Load summary from committed CSV; validate against per-seed mean and population std, then recompute each seed metric from saved OOF predictions. All displayed performance values derive from this evidence.
claims.qualification: Seed SD is not a confidence interval. No significance test, independent site evaluation or duplicate-corrected experiment exists. Original Python reports and historical TensorFlow runs remain accessible separately and are not merged with S2.

claims.claim: Figures 4, 6 and 7: parity, residuals and source-group MAE
claims.verification: All seed-0 outer rows for the selected track; Linear and Sklearn tuned from TF source plus the selected TF/PT networks. Residual=measured-predicted; group MAE is mean absolute residual.
claims.qualification: Disclosed seed is a diagnostic example, not a best seed; source-file order is not chronological. Final fitted weights never supply these charts.

claims.claim: S2 selection, convergence and framework comparability
claims.verification: README records cap-hit selection rule and October 2026 completion. Protocol JSON reports matching controls/reference checks and no warnings.
claims.qualification: Historical outer scores had already been inspected. Matching settings do not imply identical numerical optimisation or a general framework winner.

claims.claim: Deployment and scientific evidence are separate; library versions and reproduction commands
claims.verification: S2 and historical saved models stay in their registered artifact locations. Final models fit all rows and are not independently scored by their outer-CV reports. Upload training uses a session holdout. Research versions come from saved configurations; installation pins come from requirements.txt.
claims.qualification: No current affiliation, funding declaration, ethics approval, conflict-of-interest statement or external deployment validity is inferred.
